description: A shell script that defines a test for applying a patch with git am, involving setting up a repository, creating a patch file, configuring git autocrlf, committing a file, applying the patch, and verifying the result.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures git settings such as core.autocrlf.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Outputs text to the standard output.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake time used in tests.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Commits staged changes to the repository.

methods.name: git am
methods.description: Applies a patch email using git am.

methods.name: git diff-files
methods.description: Shows changes between working directory and index.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test case.
